origin.note: Walk 13's search line, at the size a larger customer's library reaches; graded against the shipped algorithm's own results and time.

title: Make search fast on 20,000 documents
objective: A customer with about 20,000 documents says search is sluggish. Make title search at least 4 times faster at that size without changing a single result: the same matches, the same order, the same 50-result limit, the same handling of archived documents, libraries and odd input. The index must still follow creates, archives and deletes. Add a test.
acceptance: Results on 20000 documents are identical to the shipped search for every query, user and archived setting
A batch of queries over 20000 documents runs at least 4 times faster than the shipped algorithm
The index still follows creates, archives and deletes
plan_summary: Titles tokenized once into a prefix index; queries start from the rarest term and stop at the limit over entries kept in result order; a test.
